metadata.name: My Stuff Descriptions for REPENTOGON
metadata.description:
[h1] My Stuff Descriptions for REPENTOGON [/h1]
Adds item descriptions and item inspection controls to the [b] My Stuff [/b] section of the pause menu in [i] The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ [/i]. The mod also supports viewing items of multiple in-game characters, including local co-op players and multi-character setups.
The mod is designed for the REPENTOGON-compatible game version and uses [b] External Item Descriptions (EID) [/b] to provide item information.
[h2] Dependencies [/h2]
This mod requires: [list] [*] [b] REPENTOGON [/b] [*] [b] External Item Descriptions (EID) [/b] [/list]
At the moment, REPENTOGON supports patch [b] v1.9.7.12 [/b] and automatically downgrades the game to that version when necessary.
Official Item Descriptions were introduced in [b] v1.9.7.13 [/b], which is newer than the version currently supported by REPENTOGON. As a result, this mod is primarily intended for the REPENTOGON-compatible [b] v1.9.7.12 [/b] environment, where the official item-description feature is not available.
[h2] Controls [/h2]
While the pause menu is open: [list] [*] Press [b] Left [/b] to enter [b] Inspect Mode [/b]. [*] Use the [b] Up, Down, Left, and Right [/b] directional controls to move the cursor between items. [*] When the cursor reaches the topmost or bottommost item, pressing [b] Up [/b] or [b] Down [/b] again switches to another character's item list, if available. [*] When the cursor reaches the rightmost item, pressing [b] Right [/b] again exits Inspect Mode and returns control to the pause menu. [/list]
